dataset.limitations: Synthetic, manually specified engineering scenarios authored by the implementation team. Not a holdout, not independent expert labels, not DEV/PROD accuracy. Intermediate-step and confidential-disclosure labels can require independent domain adjudication. No live model results have been recorded for this suite.
